author: Anurag-M1
title: smoke_ScatterElementsUpdateOutOfRangeIndices tests fail - expected ov::Exception not thrown
signature: test ScatterElementsUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices and GatherND8LayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices failed: Expected exception ov::Exception was not thrown|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: CPU functional tests / CPU functional tests
failed_jobs.symptom: 4 of 179795 smoke tests failed: all 4 parameterizations of ScatterElementsUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices (i32/f32 data x i32/i64 index) expected ov::Exception to be thrown for out-of-range index -1000 but none was thrown.

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status check failed because the CPU functional tests job failed.

key_errors: INFO:test_parallel_runner:passed test counter is: 163633 / failed test counter is: 4
root_cause: ScatterElementsUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices (src/plugins/intel_cpu/tests/functional/custom/single_layer_tests/scatter_elements_update.cpp:183) is a negative test that supplies an out-of-range index (-1000) and expects the CPU plugin to raise ov::Exception during inference. All 4 parameterizations failed because no exception was thrown, meaning the CPU ScatterElementsUpdate kernel still accepts out-of-range indices silently instead of validating and rejecting them. This is an exact repeat of signature c679b29f4fb1c2b4, previously recorded twice on 2026-11-20 against unrelated commits (#40041 touching the GPU plugin, #39332 touching HSM compile-options codec). The current triggering commit (#38097, 'Support aten::ravel operator') only adds a new PyTorch frontend operator translator (src/frontends/pytorch/src/op/ravel.cpp, op_table.cpp) and its layer tests — entirely unrelated to the CPU plugin's ScatterElementsUpdate kernel (src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/). This confirms, for a third consecutive time, a persistent, commit-independent gap in CPU plugin index bounds-checking for ScatterElementsUpdate rather than a regression introduced by any specific push.
reproduction_steps: Build the CPU plugin functional test binary and run: ./bin/intel64/Release/ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter='*smoke_ScatterElementsUpdateOutOfRangeIndices/ScatterElementsUpdateLayerCPUErrorConditionTest.ThrowsOnOutOfRangeIndices*'. Confirm no ov::Exception is thrown for the out-of-range index value -1000 on axis 0 against a (2,2) tensor.
recommended_actions: Add bounds-checking to the ScatterElementsUpdate CPU kernel (src/plugins/intel_cpu/src/nodes/scatter_update.cpp) so out-of-range indices throw ov::Exception during execution.
Treat this as a confirmed recurring systemic issue (3rd occurrence of c679b29f4fb1c2b4 in under 3 days) and escalate to CPU plugin owners rather than re-triaging per push.

Consider temporarily marking the affected ScatterElementsUpdate out-of-range parameterizations as known-failing (with a tracking ticket) to stop repeatedly red-flagging unrelated commits in post-commit CI until the kernel fix lands.
prevention_strategies: Fix the missing bounds validation once in a shared index-check helper used by all scatter/gather CPU kernels, then keep this test permanently enabled as a regression guard. Since this signature has now recurred three times against unrelated commits, open a tracking issue referencing pattern c679b29f4fb1c2b4 so future recurrences are deduplicated against a single ticket instead of being re-triaged.
historical_context: Exact repeat of signature c679b29f4fb1c2b4 (count now 3): first recorded 2026-11-20T11:47:11Z (run 44713158000, unrelated GPU commit #40041), second 2026-11-20T20:33:54Z (run 44799752720, unrelated HSM commit #39332), and now a third time against unrelated PyTorch FE commit #38097. The consistent factor across all three occurrences is that the triggering commit never touches the CPU plugin's ScatterElementsUpdate kernel, confirming this is a persistent, pre-existing gap in CPU kernel index validation rather than a new regression.
